Twemoji-Receipt.ttf is a four-glyph subset of Twemoji Mozilla v0.7.0
(https://github.com/mozilla/twemoji-colr), a COLR/CPAL build of Twemoji.

Twemoji graphics are copyright Twitter, Inc and other contributors, licensed
under CC-BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

The twemoji-colr build tooling is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

This file is a test fixture. It carries exactly four emoji plus .notdef so a
COLR v0 face with a format-12 cmap can be exercised deterministically on every
CI host without a multi-megabyte binary in the repository.
